correctness.rationale: Differentiation of the seasonally switched positive nonlinear model yields Hurwitz matrices J_A=-aI+bE12 and J_B=-aI-cE21, with a Hurwitz convex average. Matrix exponentials are exact because their off-diagonal parts square to zero. The scaled monodromy trace is 2-z² and determinant 1, with z²=bc theta(1-theta)T². Its spectral radius is 1 when z<=2 and exp(2 acosh(z/2)) when z>2. Hence strict local instability is equivalent to z>2 cosh(aT/2), including all parameter boundaries. The derivative of w/cosh(w) has a unique zero w tanh(w)=1, proving exactly zero/one/two duration boundaries, and theta(1-theta) gives the symmetric duty-cycle classification. Positive quadrant forward invariance and logistic comparisons guarantee well-defined global trajectories. A freshly replayed standard-library checker verified 25 rational matrix identities, 1,600 independent high-precision eigenvalue comparisons and all quoted sample boundary values; these are corroboration rather than replacements for proof. No conclusion is made about nonlinear stability at equality.

originality.rationale: Actual searches of published mathematical results and primary literature examined aliases (Floquet product, nilpotent shears, alternating ecological feedback), equivalent formulations, general matrix product tests, numerical ecology resonance papers, and the precise hyperbolic phase threshold. Gökçek (2004) supplies a general method and switched-system examples, but no sharp parameter partition for this specific positive nonlinear ecological model. Swailem–Rucklidge (2025) studies sinusoidal predator-prey forcing and numerical resonance tongues; its equations do not give this classification. The 2026 large-network forcing paper was accessible only by abstract and is explicitly a residual risk. Search limitations are not interpreted as proof of uniqueness. Cima–Gasull–Mañosa (2019) explicitly preempt the broad qualitative phenomenon of stability reversal under alternating stable planar fields; their theorem is credited. The new content is the all-parameter exact unique-band/duty law for the specific positive logistic, hyperbolic ecological family. Ji–Strugarek (2018) provide one-sided cooperative seasonal persistence thresholds but cannot cover a season with negative cross-influence.

value.rationale: The domain is a biologically motivated minimal two-species environment with alternating facilitation and inhibition and the same coexistence equilibrium in each season. Both environments and their weighted average are linearly stable, while a bounded interval of intermediate seasonal durations destabilizes the equilibrium. The exact all-parameter one-band criterion, universal w tanh(w)=1 threshold, and symmetric duty cycle phase diagram distinguish the limits of averaging and frozen-state reasoning and provide a sharp mechanism for season-length-induced ecological loss of resilience; these are substantial structural facts rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or a restatement of generic Floquet theory.
